title: Introduce tenant geozone assertor and audit coalescer
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private requested stronger enforcement of tenant-level geo residency constraints together with reduced audit log volume for high-throughput paths. This PR adds a tenant geozone assertor service that centralizes evaluation of location constraints and a lightweight audit coalescer that groups high-frequency, low-signal audit events before forwarding to the audit ingestion pipeline. Design: the geozone assertor evaluates request context (tenant profile, region claim, operator scope, service-level residency policies) and produces a deterministic 'geozone-decision' header which downstream components can use for routing and KMS selection. The assertor implements a small policy language (policy expressions are compiled to an internal decision graph) to avoid coupling to external policy engines. The audit coalescer runs as an opt-in filter in the request path; it maintains short-lived buckets keyed by tenant+route+event-class and emits combined summaries at configurable intervals to preserve fidelity for security-critical events while reducing noise from routine cache/hit metrics. Backwards compatibility: feature is behind flags and a staged rollout gate; default behavior is no-op for tenants without residency constraints. KMS integration: the assertor is consulted by the KMS allocator to prefer region-preferred CMKs and to attach residency-provenance attributes to encryption-context. RBAC v2: added attribute-based checks in the RBAC v2 evaluator to allow policies conditioned on geozone decisions and tenant residency labels. Testing & validation: unit tests for policy compilation, end-to-end integration tests exercising geozone decisions with simulated operator sessions, and load tests for audit coalescer (verified 3x reduction in events at 95th percentile CPU). Rollout plan: staged canary (5% tenants) -> region-limited expansion -> global release, with kill-switch feature flag and automatic fallback to legacy routing on assertor failure. Operational notes: added metrics (assertor.decision.latency, coalescer.bucket.count, coalescer.emit.rate) and alerts for decision_misses and coalescer_queue_depth. See linked Linear ticket for rollout checklist. Implementation details: central service in internal/geo/ with a gRPC façade and an HTTP adapter used by API gateway; lightweight Redis-backed short-term buckets for coalescer, with a pluggable aggregator interface for the long-term audit exporter. CI/QA: initial run hit a transient lint failure which was fixed (see commits). Security review performed and approved by Priya; data residency team validated policy expressions. This description encapsulates the changes, motivations, testing, and rollout guidance in a single narrative string.

review_comments: Diego Fernandez: Could we reduce the policy expression surface and rely on typed predicates to avoid runtime parsing overhead? Please add benchmarks.
Maya Patel (author): Added micro-benchmarks and limited expression syntax to binary predicates only. See commit 'limit policy syntax'
Priya Sharma: Verified RBAC v2 mapping and ensured audits for deny decisions are always emitted. Approving once CI green.
Liam O'Connor: Please add a threshold test for coalescer to ensure it doesn't drop security-critical events under burst scenarios. I will re-check after tests added.
Maya Patel (author): Added burst preservation test and increased coalescer high-priority bucket quota.
SRE (comment): Observability looks sufficient; recommend a follow-up to add a dashboard tile for decision distribution by tenant.
release_notes: Add tenant geozone assertor to evaluate residency policies and route requests to region-preferred KMS; introduce an opt-in audit coalescer to reduce high-frequency audit noise while preserving security-critical event fidelity. Feature is behind a feature flag and will be rolled out via staged canary. Metrics and alerts added for operational visibility.
notes_for_ops: Gate is feature flag 'geo.assertor.enabled'. Can be disabled globally via admin-console. KMS allocator will attach 'residency.provenance' attribute when assertor returns a region recommendation. If assertor is unreachable, requests fallback to legacy routing; ensure fallback alarm is unmuted during rollout.
